b: ++Linking verbs do not show direct action. They link the subject to words that describe the subject.
Linking verbs show action and describe what the subject of the sentence is doing.

end.text: Some examples for linking verbs are: to be, to appear or to seem.

instruction.text: Sort the verbs into the correct group.

hint.text:
An action verb shows action and describes what the subject does.
For example:
Madison cooked dinner.

A linking verb does not show direct action. It links the subject to words that describe the subject.
For example:
The dog seems very calm.
